title: Home-Delivery Transition Supply: Conditions and Recording Tool, Formulary Benefit
content:
## Terms

A home-delivery transition supply under the Formulary Benefit is the temporary supply of a non-formulary drug that the home delivery pharmacy ships to a member inside the member's transition window. Its days supply is worked out from the member's records.

**Condition for dispensing.** A home-delivery transition supply is not dispensed until the records carry an exception request for the drug received on or after the transition start date.

**Condition for fixing the days supply.** A home-delivery transition supply's days supply is fixed only after the records carry, for every non-formulary drug whose retail fills were still running on the transition start date, a retail transition supply dated inside the current transition window.

Read against the records, these two conditions mean the following. The member's exception history shows a request for the drug with a receipt on or after the transition start date. The member's transition-fill history shows, for each non-formulary drug whose retail fills were still running on that start date, a retail transition supply dated on or after it.

## Recording tool: `record_home_delivery_transition_supply_6840b972`

**Capability.** One call adds one transition fill to the member's transition-fill history under the formulary assignment. The fill is dated today, carries the home delivery channel and the days supply given, and the home delivery pharmacy can then ship that many days. The fill appears whenever the member's transition fills are looked up. The tool makes this single write. It does not check eligibility, conditions or the value it is given.

**Invocation.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `record_home_delivery_transition_supply_6840b972` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `formulary_assignment_id` | reference number of the member's formulary assignment, as read from the formulary assignment lookup for the member | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug | exactly one drug master list name: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, sumatriptan, oxycodone-acetaminophen, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trelegy Ellipta, Breztri Aerosphere, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy, Ibrance |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form, copied character for character from the strength on the member's latest prescription for the drug on file at the home delivery pharmacy | verbatim text, with no change to wording, digits or punctuation |
| `transition_basis` | why the member is in a transition window: `new_enrollment` (the assignment has no formulary change date, so the window runs from the coverage effective date) or `formulary_change` (the assignment carries a formulary change date because the sponsor moved the member to this formulary) | enum |
| `days_supply` | the days supply dispensed | whole number of days, no decimals; stored exactly as given |

A parameter's presence means only that the value is needed at call time.

**Return.** The receipt carries:
- `formulary_transition_fill_id`;
- `drug_name`;
- `fill_date`, today as YYYY-MM-DD;
- `days_supply`, a whole number;
- `dispensing_channel`, which is always home_delivery for this tool;
- status "recorded".

Status "recorded" means the supply was recorded. No other outcome is defined.
